name: Figure/Pattern Completion
shortcutSummary: Look at the incomplete figure and identify its symmetry (vertical, horizontal, or rotational). The missing part must complete the symmetry pattern.
conceptExplanation: Figure Completion questions show an incomplete figure/pattern and ask you to select the piece that correctly completes it. The completed figure usually has a specific symmetry or follows a logical pattern.

subtopics.name: Figure/Pattern Completion — Core Concepts
subtopics.explanation: Figure Completion questions show an incomplete figure/pattern and ask you to select the piece that correctly completes it. The completed figure usually has a specific symmetry or follows a logical pattern.
shortcuts: Symmetry Detection: Most figures have vertical or horizontal symmetry — the missing piece should mirror the existing part.
Line Continuity: Lines at the boundary of the missing piece must continue smoothly from the existing figure.
Pattern Consistency: Shading, line thickness, and element spacing must be consistent.

practiceQuestions.questionText: Select a figure from the options which will continue the pattern and complete the incomplete bottom-right quadrant of a square divided into four quadrants by perpendicular axes, where each existing quadrant has two concentric circular arcs connected to the central origin and a shaded diagonal line:
options: Figure with concentric circular arcs curving outward towards bottom-right corner
Figure with a single straight diagonal line without any circular arcs
Figure with perpendicular cross lines and no diagonal stroke
Figure with two concentric circular arcs curving inward towards the top-left of the quadrant and a diagonal line extending to the bottom-right corner
practiceQuestions.hint: Analyze the symmetry of the figure: diagonal reflection, horizontal reflection, or rotational symmetry.
practiceQuestions.explanation: To maintain four-fold radial symmetry around the center, the bottom-right quadrant must complete the concentric arcs towards the origin with a corresponding outward diagonal stroke.
practiceQuestions.solutionSteps:
Step 1: Check the line continuity and curvature across the adjacent quadrants.
Step 2: Note the orientation of shading and terminal vertices.
Step 3: Select the exact matching piece: Figure with two concentric circular arcs curving inward towards the top-left of the quadrant and a diagonal line extending to the bottom-right corner.

practiceQuestions.questionText: Select a figure from the options which will continue the pattern and complete the incomplete missing top-right quadrant of a diamond figure, where symmetrical floral design where each quadrant contains an equilateral petal and two parallel diagonal hatching lines:
options: Figure with leaf petal pointing towards bottom-left instead of top-right
Figure with leaf petal pointing towards top-right but with a single horizontal hatching stroke
Figure containing a symmetrical leaf petal pointing towards top-right with two parallel hatching strokes matching the left quadrant
Figure with a blank petal without internal hatching strokes
practiceQuestions.hint: Analyze the symmetry of the figure: diagonal reflection, horizontal reflection, or rotational symmetry.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The overall composite pattern has bilateral symmetry along the vertical axis; thus the top-right quadrant is an exact lateral reflection of the top-left quadrant.
practiceQuestions.solutionSteps:
Step 1: Check the line continuity and curvature across the adjacent quadrants.
Step 2: Note the orientation of shading and terminal vertices.
Step 3: Select the exact matching piece: Figure containing a symmetrical leaf petal pointing towards top-right with two parallel hatching strokes matching the left quadrant.

practiceQuestions.questionText: Select a figure from the options which will continue the pattern and complete the incomplete bottom-left missing segment of a circular mandala, where three alternating shaded and unshaded concentric rings with radial spoke lines:
options: A quadrant wedge with all three concentric rings shaded solid dark
A quadrant wedge with outer and inner rings shaded and middle ring open
A quadrant wedge with the middle ring shaded dark and outer and inner rings open, bisected by a radial spoke line
A quadrant wedge with middle ring shaded but lacking the radial spoke line
practiceQuestions.hint: Analyze the symmetry of the figure: diagonal reflection, horizontal reflection, or rotational symmetry.
practiceQuestions.explanation: Extending the alternating concentric rings into the third quadrant preserves the continuity of dark shading in the middle band.
practiceQuestions.solutionSteps:
Step 1: Check the line continuity and curvature across the adjacent quadrants.
Step 2: Note the orientation of shading and terminal vertices.
Step 3: Select the exact matching piece: A quadrant wedge with the middle ring shaded dark and outer and inner rings open, bisected by a radial spoke line.

practiceQuestions.questionText: Select a figure from the options which will continue the pattern and complete the incomplete missing lower-right section of a 2x2 grid, where a diagonal cross with small circles at each outer vertex and small squares at each edge midpoint:
